item.title: Gooey Audio offers Talkie formant filter plugin for FREE until February 20th
item.description: Gooey Audio has released Talkie, a simple formant filter plugin for macOS and Windows. The plugin is available at no cost for a limited time until February 20th, 2026. item.title: RCJacH releases FREE RCSiner distortion plugin for Windows and macOS
item.description: RCJacH has released RCSiner, a free distortion plugin for macOS and Windows, now available as a standalone plugin.
